about: NO_WAIT_40.md (section 33): nothing waits for Wi-Fi (SDK 4.0.2). Made by tools/nowait40.py --write; do not edit by hand. Each SDK replays the cases that name it, against a stand-in server, with its connection report set to the case's.

cases.name: first_install_metered
cases.about: a first install on mobile data goes ahead, as it always did

cases.name: first_install_unknown
cases.about: the platform cannot tell the network

cases.name: prefetch_metered
cases.about: prefetch() has no network option and downloads on mobile data

cases.name: prefetch_data_saver
cases.about: the data saver or Low Data Mode is on: the SDK still sends its requests (the system may hold them)

cases.name: other_context_metered
cases.about: the 4.0.1 report: prefetch() installed the default context, then a session on another context on mobile data; its files download and the session opens (4.0.1: model_missing at every retry)

cases.name: other_context_low_data
cases.about: the same with the data saver or Low Data Mode on

cases.name: other_context_none
cases.about: the same with no network at all: needs_connection, and the cause says the model files are missing (not model_missing)

cases.name: update_metered
cases.about: a newer build of the default context named by the config: the update downloads on mobile data

cases.name: accelerator_metered
cases.about: the accelerator build (Core ML, an NPU program), the lease allowing programs, after a session: it downloads on mobile data and the pipeline goes on

cases.name: sharing_upload_metered
cases.about: a finished shared recording uploads on mobile data (no upload option waits)

cases.name: first_install_none
cases.about: no network at all on a first install: needs_connection, the cause says the model

cases.name: queued_by_401_metered
cases.about: a download 4.0.1 left waiting for an unmetered network (an owed download marked unmetered only, a background task made with an unmetered-only request) goes on after the update
